title: UzEngine Control Rig
description: UzEngine control rig file (.uzcontrolrig) — procedural animation rig with IK solvers, bone constraints, and runtime-driven modifications. Applied as a post-process after animation evaluation to achieve foot placement, look-at, aim correction, and procedural secondary motion.

skeleton.description: Path to the skeleton asset (.uzskeleton) this rig operates on.

solvers.description: Ordered list of IK solvers and constraints. Evaluated sequentially — order matters when solvers share bones.

type.description: Solver algorithm. 'fabrik': Forward And Backward Reaching IK. 'ccd': Cyclic Coordinate Descent. 'two_bone': analytical 2-bone (elbow/knee). 'look_at': orient bone toward target. 'aim': rotate bone chain to aim at target. 'twist_chain': distribute twist along a bone chain. 'spring_bone': physics-based secondary motion (hair, tails, cloth).

chain.description: Ordered bone names from root to tip of the IK chain.

target_bone.description: Bone that provides the IK target position (for look_at, aim). If omitted, target is set from gameplay code.

weight.description: Solver blend weight. 0 = pure animation, 1 = fully IK-driven.

iterations.description: Max solver iterations per frame (FABRIK/CCD only). More = more accurate but slower.

tolerance.description: Convergence tolerance in meters. Solver stops early if end-effector is within this distance of target.

pole_vector.description: Pole vector direction [x, y, z] for two_bone IK. Controls elbow/knee bend direction.

constraints.description: Per-bone joint limits applied during IK solve.

min_angle.description: Minimum rotation in degrees [pitch, yaw, roll].

max_angle.description: Maximum rotation in degrees [pitch, yaw, roll].

stiffness.description: Spring stiffness. Higher = snappier return to rest pose.

damping.description: Velocity damping. 0 = no damping (infinite oscillation), 1 = critically damped.

gravity.description: Gravity force applied to spring bones.

wind_influence.description: How much global wind affects these bones [0..1].

collision_radius.description: Sphere collision radius for self-collision avoidance (meters).
